title: Unit Event — This Moment With You! — Episode8 Whatever the Feeling

meta.Event Outline: Leo/need's debut single is taking off. Thanks to the impact of their VIRTUAL SINGER version, their label expresses hopes that the band will create VIRTUAL SINGER versions of all future songs. But Ichika seems hesitant...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I can't seem to get my thoughts together...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I feel like I can do this, but I'm also still worried. I don't know what to do...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So, if you do decide to write that song, what do you want it to be about?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, umm...
I was going to talk with Saki to see how it might work musically...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But since the theme is “This Moment With You!”, I thought that we could try writing a song about all the memories the four of us have, and the time we've spent with you and the others at this school, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So, I'm thinking that we make something a bit up-tempo with a scintillating melody...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I see. I'm sure it'd be a lovely song.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
But still...
This reminds me of that one time.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: When you said that you wanted to sing with me, remember? We sang that song you wrote together.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And I got to sing with all of you during your last show before you went pro.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That moment... Getting to be with you... Getting to sing with you made me so happy.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Every second of that moment means the world to me. It's a memory that I'm going to cherish forever...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Right now, I'm trying to come up with a song for this collaboration... For Leo/need... For you to sing...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But I have a feeling that I won't be having you sing it for the same reasons as before...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Which is why I'm hesitating so much right now...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You just mentioned how you're not sure if it's okay to have me sing a song for reasons that you don't see as being entirely pure...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But I'll be more than happy to sing any songs that you ask me to do.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Regardless of who they're for or what feelings went into them...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I like the songs you write, Ichika.
And the songs you have me sing...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I've been wondering whether I have the right feelings going into this.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (But Miku's happy to accept whatever I'm feeling and sing whatever I write for her.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: All you have to do now is make a decision...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Alright, Ms. Hoshino, let me hear your answer.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I have no problem with the idea of releasing VIRTUAL SINGER versions of the songs we're going to release.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: However... I don't want to commit to doing that for every song we produce in the future.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I know I sound very selfish right now...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But I care deeply about Miku and the other VIRTUAL SINGERS...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And I think that feeling is an integral part of my music... It shapes my songwriting process and the way I play.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So, I'd rather not have Miku sing a song that I don't feel 100% comfortable with her performing.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Which is why I want us to have the power to decide whether we're going to release a VIRTUAL SINGER version, or if we're going to have the Leo/need version stand alone.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
Please, try to relax.
The company will need to know about this, but I'll handle telling them.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Explaining this to them won't be easy, but I'm sure things will work out.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: I accept what you just said as your conviction regarding this matter instead of anything selfish.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: That being said, you all just made a rather perilous decision as professional musicians. I hope you understand what this is going to mean...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: So, what are your plans regarding our collaboration in question?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We plan on accepting their offer.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
For this song...
I have a sense that it'll work for both Leo/need and Miku.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: All the moments we've spent together as Leo/need, as well as all the moments I've spent with Miku...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Both of those things mean a great deal to me, so my goal will be to channel those feelings into this song.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And that's why I'd like to have Miku sing it too.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: That shouldn't be a problem, so let's get the ball rolling for this collaboration, shall we?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I'm sorry for making you all wait...
Let's do our best to produce a great song for this collaboration.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Let's make it the best song ever!

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Writing this song is obviously important, but please also make sure to keep practicing.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Don't forget that you need to start preparing for Jam Fest soon.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
He's right.
We also need to give that everything we have.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We get to perform in our first show as pros at Jam Fest, so we need to make it a successful performance...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (We're going to blow everyone away by writing the best song ever for this collaboration and by putting on an amazing performance at Jam Fest.)
